organizations.name: ACLU (American Civil Liberties Union)
organizations.eligibility: Anyone; intake goes through your state affiliate
organizations.what_they_help_with: Civil rights and civil liberties cases — discrimination, free speech, immigrants' rights, voting rights. State affiliates take local cases and track state laws.

organizations.name: NAACP Legal Defense Fund (LDF)
organizations.eligibility: Cases with broad civil rights impact, focused on racial justice
organizations.what_they_help_with: Racial discrimination litigation — education, economic justice, criminal justice, political participation.

organizations.name: Lawyers' Committee for Civil Rights Under Law
organizations.eligibility: People facing racial discrimination; connects to pro bono attorneys
organizations.what_they_help_with: Connecting discrimination victims with free private attorneys; voting rights; hate incident reporting.

organizations.name: Legal Services Corporation (Find Legal Aid)
organizations.eligibility: Low-income (usually under 125% of the federal poverty line)
organizations.what_they_help_with: Locator for the free civil legal aid office serving your county — evictions, benefits denials, family law, consumer problems.
